title: Nuanced pause generation for em-dashes and punctuation hints across TTS backends
description: Add nuanced pause handling for em-dashes (—, --, ―, parenthetical –) and pause punctuation hints (ellipses, explicit pause markers) across TTS backends. Block breaks (h1-h6, p, blockquote, li) remain as paragraph breaks (~400-500ms). Punctuation pauses insert a brief silence gap (~200ms) so speech does not rush past em-dashes. Re-generate all example audio assets locally with MLX and update S3 and DynamoDB.
